hook: Your AI gives the same answer to you as it does to a 19-year-old marketing intern. Let that sink in.
caption:
Your AI gives the same answer to you as it does to a 19-year-old marketing intern. Let that sink in.

You have 12 years of experience. Strong opinions about process. You hate when people over-explain things you already know. You think in systems, not steps.

But every time you open ChatGPT, it starts from zero.

It doesn't know you default to skepticism before buy-in.
It doesn't know you want the counterargument first.
It doesn't know that "can you simplify this" means sharpen it — not dumb it down.

So it gives you the same polished, hedge-everything, explain-it-like-you're-new response it gives everyone.

And you spend the next 4 messages trying to drag it toward something actually useful.

That gap — between how you think and how AI responds by default — is exactly what BootFile fixes.

Your BootFile is a personalized AI instruction profile built around your thinking style, your standards, and the way you actually process information.

You load it once. Every session starts calibrated to you.

Not the intern. You.
